_comment: Shipped non-code assets that carry a third-party license. Every file under public/fonts must be recorded here and is pinned by sha256, so replacing a font without updating this record fails `gen:sbom-versions:check`. Name, version and copyright are read from the font file's own name table; the license is what that table points to. Fredoka and Nunito are the Latin subsets (made with fontTools pyftsubset; Fredoka also fixed at width 100, keeping the weight axis) of the variable fonts in the Google Fonts repository at the commit named in `source`; `sourceSha256` is the unmodified upstream file. The OFL text beside each font is the repository's own OFL.txt.

assets.name: Inter (variable font, latin subset)
assets.licenseSource: the font's own name table (name ID 14) points to https://openfontlicense.org

assets.name: Fredoka (variable font, latin subset)
assets.licenseSource: OFL.txt in the Google Fonts repository (ofl/fredoka/OFL.txt), copied to public/fonts/OFL-Fredoka.txt; the font's name table carries no licence URL

assets.name: Nunito (variable font, latin subset)
assets.licenseSource: OFL.txt in the Google Fonts repository (ofl/nunito/OFL.txt), copied to public/fonts/OFL-Nunito.txt; the font's name table carries no licence URL
